_meta.title: Scrape 4 gap-fill — priority-city specific-place enrichment
_meta.site_character: Travel guide. Its standard city pages typically cover dedicated bars, saunas and cruising businesses, which are not new Cruising Area records.
limits: No individual exact GPS coordinates obtained from a verified map check; do not invent or copy an unverified city centroid.
Guide headings say 2026 but do not establish recent individual-site activity.
Do not turn broad gay neighbourhood or a pop-up bar into a public cruising spot unless credible specific evidence is obtained.
Where multiple sources already identify a park or public toilet, this is enrichment, not a new place.
Keep source article content paraphrased and all source URLs preserved.
Public reports of crowd/time and enforcement are source claims only and may have changed.
review_attention: Existing flagged Volkspark Friedrichshain stays flagged; older source is not a resolution.
Maspalomas is a protected nature area with reported fines and park restrictions; need independent current local rule verification.
Two reported Mykonos coastal areas require rock/water caution and exact mapping.
Commercial toilet facilities require proper permissions and current facility verification.
